title: Secret Injection Diff
summary: Prove which processes gain secret names before a pull request merges.
user: A developer using IDEs, CI, and deployment tools who needs to prove which process receives which secret names and whether that scope changed in a pull request.
smallest_useful_product: Local CLI that parses declared env, Compose, CI, and Kubernetes manifests; reports only secret identifiers and recipient boundaries; fails CI when an undeclared recipient gains a secret.
constraints: Never retain or transmit values; treat names as sensitive enough to redact in shared reports; require adapters rather than guessing arbitrary secret-manager semantics.
